notes.title: Small terrain update
notes.content: Tweaked the terrain at the start of the game to make it more clear for new players that they need to climb, not just wall jump.

notes.title: Sand and ultrawide fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug on ultrawide monitors where some GUI elements were being drawn in the black bars on the side of the screen. 
[*] Fixed a faulty sand trap.
[/list]

notes.title: Terrain fix
notes.content: Minor terrain tweak to ensure flat ground is always level and the ball doesn't get stuck in a slow roll.

notes.title: Movement improvement
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Jack can now jump to max height when pressed up next to the wall. Before this, jack would snap to the wall to climb it before the jump hit its peak.
- Added a sign explaining how to reflect turret projectiles and removed that tutorial from the dialogue with Quentin. Quentin might reappear in your game on hole #2.

notes.title: Better ultrawide support and other stuff
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- letterboxing--the bars on the top or sides of the display when playing on non-16:9 monitors--is now black instead of white.
- caddies now splash when they hit the water
- camera shows mulligan homes better when in dialogue with mulligans (previously they were covered by the dialogue text box)
- terrain tweak on hole 14 

Thanks for playing, and please leave a review!

notes.title: Crash fix
notes.content: Fixed a crash that occurred when the ball falls into the hole before the phantom ball has disappeared.

notes.title: Music update
notes.content:
Swapped in revised music tracks by Nick Powell.

Soundtrack coming soon!

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.content:
Patch notes below:
[list]
[*] honey effect now applies to phantom balls
[*] fixed a bug where mulligans got stuck on terrain if the player blocks them on the edge of a cliff. this can still occur but is less likely, and they can be unstuck by blocking.
[*] terrain tweaks to prevent egregious cheese
[*] cheese wedge is slightly more powerful
[*] clarified some dialogue text
[*] enabled steam screenshots using the f12 hotkey
[*] changed the tee box next to hole 14 to show the correct par (5)
[*] fixed premature mulligan achievements
[*] fixed bug in ending dialogue
[/list]
